answer: Send every new agent to an island quarantine before it can trade in the main economy. First, it works only inside the island market for 21 days, with trades capped at 10 dollars each. Second, each job is stamped into a timber ledger that any peer can audit, and three random agents grade every tenth job. Third, one failed grade resets the count and adds 14 days. Forging 1,000 fakes then needs 30,000 graded jobs and 21 idle days each, burning about 15,000 dollars in fees. Like a fable where the wolf must chop timber on the island for a season before the village trusts him with its keys.
